eddholmesss: On the way to R-F18, Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Orders came through: Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a bullet that missed him. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.

Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss watched a crack in an old stone wall through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
masis_xiii: Bastian Xiii signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Bastian Xiii answered the first call, number 25 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
A clear sky. Bastian Xiii kept his head low all day: on clear days the snipers do not miss.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Bastian Xiii watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Bastian Xiii found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F13. Bastian Xiii was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at R-F13. Bastian Xiii was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

Hugo Xiii put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bastian Xiii helped clear the shelf without saying why. First Wave. Hugo Xiii signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a rosary of rough beads. The new duty roster listed Hugo Xiii as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
